Rusty Sword.name: Rusty Sword
Rusty Sword.flavor: Bent near the crossguard where a Thornwick taxman tried to parry a cartwheel.
Rusty Sword.inspect: Pitted by river fog along the Border Fords. Still keen enough to settle tavern debts, though the tang rattles inside its shrunken hide grip.

Iron Sword.name: Iron Sword
Iron Sword.flavor: Issued to Alder Bridge pickets before the spring floods washed their barracks away.
Iron Sword.inspect: Forged from bog-smelted ore that smudges oiled rags. Dependable if you keep the bevel away from granite and bone.

Steel Sword.name: Steel Sword
Steel Sword.flavor: Balanced by a Greywood smith who lost three fingers testing its temper.
Steel Sword.inspect: A clean fuller runs two-thirds down the flat, singing faintly when drawn. Watchmen in Oakhaven trade two months' scrip for metalwork this honest.

Knight Sword.name: Knight Sword
Knight Sword.flavor: The pommel bears a filed-off crest from a disgraced Border Fords barony.
Knight Sword.inspect: Watered alloy folded until faint ripples show beneath the grease. Whoever owned it before died with their visor up and their purse still buckled.

Thorn Blade.name: Thorn Blade
Thorn Blade.flavor: Grown rather than forged; sap still beads along its serrated fuller.
Thorn Blade.inspect: Cut from a petrified briar at the root of the Sunken Sanctum. Flesh parts around its jagged teeth as if eager to escape the edge.

Oak Staff.name: Oak Staff
Oak Staff.flavor: Charred at the ferrule where an apprentice mistook swamp gas for hearth smoke.
Oak Staff.inspect: Seasoned bog-timber bound in tarnished wire. It smells of wet bark and scorched eyebrows whenever sparks gather at its crown.

Ash Staff.name: Ash Staff
Ash Staff.flavor: Carved with tally marks by a Redmarsh hedge-witch who stopped counting at forty.
Ash Staff.inspect: Heartwood stripped from lightning-split trees. Channeling through it feels like holding a taut bowstring in a sleet storm.

Rune Staff.name: Rune Staff
Rune Staff.flavor: Its inlaid glyphs hum low enough to loosen fillings in nearby teeth.
Rune Staff.inspect: Etched by Lantern Passage scholars before the ink-vaults flooded. Each sigil drinks ambient warmth, leaving rime on the wielder's knuckles.

Star Staff.name: Star Staff
Star Staff.flavor: Crowned with a meteorite shard that refuses to cool even in river ice.
Star Staff.inspect: Recovered from a crater north of the Iron Coast. Staring directly at its fractured core leaves violet afterimages across the battlefield.

Thorn Staff.name: Thorn Staff
Thorn Staff.flavor: Roots coil tightly around a core that twitches near spilled blood.
Thorn Staff.inspect: Harvested from the living gallows of the Ember Court. It murmurs in dead dialects when fed aether, tightening its clasp on the caster's wrist.

Wooden Buckler.name: Wooden Buckler
Wooden Buckler.flavor: Planked from an ale cask; the inside still smells of sour barley.
Wooden Buckler.inspect: Reinforced with a single boss hammered flat on an anvil stone. Good for turning aside a cudgel, hopeless against anything weightier.

Iron Shield.name: Iron Shield
Iron Shield.flavor: Dented inward by a boar tusk at the edge of the Greywood.
Iron Shield.inspect: Rim-bound oak faced with hammered grey sheet. Burdensome on the forearm after a league's march, yet comforting when arrows start falling.

Tower Shield.name: Tower Shield
Tower Shield.flavor: Scorched along the lower rim from holding a burning doorway at Ravenwatch.
Tower Shield.inspect: Tall enough to kneel behind while quarrels splinter against the planks. Two painted eyes stare from the front, one half-scraped off by shrapnel.

Knight Shield.name: Knight Shield
Knight Shield.flavor: Polished to a dull mirror despite three gouges across the heraldry.
Knight Shield.inspect: Laminated ash beneath fluted plate built to deflect lance tips. The arm-straps are padded with wolfskin rubbed smooth by gauntlets.

Leather Cap.name: Leather Cap
Leather Cap.flavor: Stitched from boiled bullhide with one ear-flap chewed off by kennel pups.
Leather Cap.inspect: Cracked along the crown where rain dried too fast beside a campfire. Better than bare scalp when sling-stones start dropping.

Iron Helm.name: Iron Helm
Iron Helm.flavor: The nasal bar is bent slightly left, forcing the wearer to cock their head.
Iron Helm.inspect: Riveted from two halves over a greasy wool liner. Every blow against the dome rings like a cracked chapel bell inside your skull.

Steel Helm.name: Steel Helm
Steel Helm.flavor: Slotted visor hinges still hold dried salt from the Iron Coast garrisons.
Steel Helm.inspect: Angled cheek-plates guide blade tips away from the throat. Veterans keep a spare chin-strap tucked inside the crown just in case.

Scholar Hat.name: Scholar Hat
Scholar Hat.flavor: Moth-eaten brim stiffened with wax and stained with violet ink.
Scholar Hat.inspect: Used by census clerks who accompanied early expeditions into Redmarsh. The wide brim keeps drizzle off parchment, though little else.

Wizard Hat.name: Wizard Hat
Wizard Hat.flavor: Sewn from midnight felt lined with copper thread that crackles in dry wind.
Wizard Hat.inspect: Its crooked peak leans away from drafty corridors and incoming hexes alike. Dust motes orbit the brim when spells are being readied.

Padded Jerkin.name: Padded Jerkin
Padded Jerkin.flavor: Stuffed with horsehair and tow; smells strongly of wet sheep in the rain.
Padded Jerkin.inspect: Quilted canvas worn beneath mail or alone by penniless recruits. Stops splinters and shallow cuts while catching every burr in the fen.

Chain Mail.name: Chain Mail
Chain Mail.flavor: Thousands of riveted links, twelve of them replaced with mismatched brass wire.
Chain Mail.inspect: Taken off a deserter who drowned trying to swim the Thornwick ford. Weighty across the shoulders, chill as a grave at dawn.

Plate Armor.name: Plate Armor
Plate Armor.flavor: Articulated lames blackened with soot to hide bright metal during night marches.
Plate Armor.inspect: Fitted by Ironcamp armorers who charge by the pound and never bargain. A direct mace blow still bruises, though your ribs stay whole.

Cloth Robe.name: Cloth Robe
Cloth Robe.flavor: Hemmed with mud from a dozen Border Fords ditches and patched at both elbows.
Cloth Robe.inspect: Unbleached homespun dyed with walnut hulls. Offers no shelter from blades, only pockets for chalk, dried roots, and tallow stubs.

Mage Robe.name: Mage Robe
Mage Robe.flavor: Woven with silver-dipped silk that sheds bog-water like a duck's back.
Mage Robe.inspect: Tailored for Oakhaven tower adepts who disliked scorched cuffs. Faint wards stitched into the seams tingle when hostile magic draws near.

Star Robe.name: Star Robe
Star Robe.flavor: Velvet dusted with crushed moonstone that glitters only in shadow.
Star Robe.inspect: Looped with gold wire tracing constellations no longer visible over Thornvael. Arrows seem to hesitate a fraction before striking its folds.

Sandals.name: Sandals
Sandals.flavor: Thongs cut from frayed bridle hide, mended twice with tarred twine.
Sandals.inspect: Built for dry cobbles rather than ankle-deep fen sludge. At least they dry out fast beside a banked fire.

Leather Boots.name: Leather Boots
Leather Boots.flavor: Hobnailed soles ground smooth on the outer heels from long patrol routes.
Leather Boots.inspect: Greased calfskin reaching mid-calf to keep leeches out of your hose. Every mercenary in Thornwick knows good boots outlast good vows.

Iron Boots.name: Iron Boots
Iron Boots.flavor: Sabaton plates clack like a skeleton dancing on flagstones.
Iron Boots.inspect: Articulated metal over thick hide soles meant for holding narrow breaches. Nobody runs in them, and nobody easily pushes you backward.

Swift Boots.name: Swift Boots
Swift Boots.flavor: Supple elkhide stitched with sinew so light they barely press the mud.
Swift Boots.inspect: Favored by couriers running dispatches between Oakhaven and the coast. The soles leave almost no heel-print even in damp clay.

Ring of Might.name: Ring of Might
Ring of Might.flavor: Band hammered around a sliver of lodestone.
Ring of Might.inspect: Belonged to a pit-fighter in Thornwick until a debt collector took his finger. Warm to the touch whenever muscles strain.

Ring of Grace.name: Ring of Grace
Ring of Grace.flavor: Twisted silver wire thin enough to bend if squeezed between two thumbs.
Ring of Grace.inspect: Found in the velvet jewelry box of an Ember Court dancer. The band settles naturally against the knuckle, steadying trembling hands.

Ring of Insight.name: Ring of Insight
Ring of Insight.flavor: Set with a cloudy beryl that clears briefly whenever a lie is spoken nearby.
Ring of Insight.inspect: Forged for archivists cataloging the Undervault ruins. Wearing it makes lamp-light seem sharper and margins easier to read.

Ring of Calm.name: Ring of Calm
Ring of Calm.flavor: River-pebble band carved from a single piece of jade.
Ring of Calm.inspect: Given to watchmen stationed along the howling cliffs of Iron Coast. Pulse-beats slow against its cool inner surface.

Great Ring of Might.name: Great Ring of Might
Great Ring of Might.flavor: Twin bands of meteoric ore welded over a pulsing garnet core.
Great Ring of Might.inspect: Once belonged to a siege-breaker who lifted a portcullis alone at Alder Bridge. Heat radiates into the tendons of the sword-arm.

Great Ring of Grace.name: Great Ring of Grace
Great Ring of Grace.flavor: Filigree platinum loop that feels lighter than the air it displaces.
Great Ring of Grace.inspect: Crafted by blind jewelers of the pre-Ashen court. Wearers move as though wind were always at their heels.

Great Ring of Insight.name: Great Ring of Insight
Great Ring of Insight.flavor: An unblinking sapphire set in gold that reflects rooms differently.
Great Ring of Insight.inspect: Recovered from a drowned observatory beneath Redmarsh. Thoughts line up like soldiers on parade while it rests on your hand.

Great Ring of Calm.name: Great Ring of Calm
Great Ring of Calm.flavor: Obsidian hoop veined with silver that swallows nearby clatter.
Great Ring of Calm.inspect: Carried by inquisitors during Ember Court trials to keep their hands steady. Panic slides off the mind like rain off slate.

Ember Charm.name: Ember Charm
Ember Charm.flavor: Charred bone pendant enclosing a cinder that has glowed for thirty winters.
Ember Charm.inspect: Hung around the necks of charcoal burners working the Greywood. Keeps frostbite from the fingers even when campfires die.

Frost Charm.name: Frost Charm
Frost Charm.flavor: Rime-coated glass vial holding a single snowflake suspended in oil.
Frost Charm.inspect: Traded down from northern whalers who wrecked along the Ferric Coast. Cold sweats bead on the chain whenever flames flare close.

Storm Charm.name: Storm Charm
Storm Charm.flavor: Fulgerite shard bound in copper wire that smells sharply of ozone.
Storm Charm.inspect: Picked from a blasted oak outside Ravenwatch. The pendant jerks northward seconds before thunder cracks overhead.

Stone Charm.name: Stone Charm
Stone Charm.flavor: Chipped granite disc carved with a mason's plumb-line and three dots.
Stone Charm.inspect: Carried by quarrymen in the pits of Redmarsh to ward off cave-ins. Feels twice as weighty whenever ground begins to tremble.

Life Charm.name: Life Charm
Life Charm.flavor: Braided red thread coiled around a seed that still rattles inside its husk.
Life Charm.inspect: Sold by midwives in Thornwick after bad harvests. Its warmth steadies shallow breathing when bandages run red.

Mind Charm.name: Mind Charm
Mind Charm.flavor: Tarnished argent locket containing a folded scrap of mirrored foil.
Mind Charm.inspect: Kept by Lantern Passage scribes during all-night vigils. Keeps fog from creeping behind the eyes after days without sleep.

Ward Charm.name: Ward Charm
Ward Charm.flavor: Lead-sealed brass talisman stamped with four crossed keys.
Ward Charm.inspect: Issued to captains marching against Ember Court hexers. The pendant grows scalding hot just before a curse strikes home.

Healing Draught.name: Healing Draught
Healing Draught.flavor: Tastes like boiled nettles and copper pennies; do not sniff before swallowing.
Healing Draught.inspect: Brewed in clay jugs by Thornwick apothecaries. Knits torn meat together fast enough to itch, leaving puckered scars behind.

Greater Healing Draught.name: Greater Healing Draught
Greater Healing Draught.flavor: Thick as tallow and glowing faintly pink; swirl well or chew the sediment.
Greater Healing Draught.inspect: Distilled from red-cap moss harvested only after Redmarsh blood-rains. Closes gashes in seconds while leaving your tongue numb for hours.

Mana Draught.name: Mana Draught
Mana Draught.flavor: Fizzy blue brine that turns your teeth indigo and makes your ears ring.
Mana Draught.inspect: Steeped from crushed glow-lichen scraped off Undervault pillars. Restores spent focus at the cost of a brief, sharp headache.

Greater Mana Draught.name: Greater Mana Draught
Greater Mana Draught.flavor: Smells of crushed stars and vinegar; never drink within an hour of open flame.
Greater Mana Draught.inspect: Refined in glass retorts by Oakhaven alchemists. Floods parched channels with clarity until sparks dance off your fingernails.

Elixir of Body.name: Elixir of Body
Elixir of Body.flavor: Swallow in one gulp; spitting it out wastes coin and stains floorboards forever.
Elixir of Body.inspect: Boiled down from marrow, filings, and bitter root. Leaves muscles tight as drawn bowstrings long after the bottle is empty.

Elixir of Agility.name: Elixir of Agility
Elixir of Agility.flavor: Shimmers like mercury in the phial and makes your knees twitch before uncorking.
Elixir of Agility.inspect: Compounded with wasp venom and distilled fen-mint. The world seems to drag its feet for a heartbeat after the last drop goes down.

Elixir of Mind.name: Elixir of Mind
Elixir of Mind.flavor: Clear as rain until tilted, revealing tiny motes that spell forgotten words.
Elixir of Mind.inspect: Brewed in silence by hooded archivists of Lantern Passage. Sharpens recall until every old mistake feels freshly minted.

Elixir of Spirit.name: Elixir of Spirit
Elixir of Spirit.flavor: Warm as mulled wine and thick with gold leaf that clings to the throat.
Elixir of Spirit.inspect: Blessed over braziers in the chapels before the Ember Court schism. Steadies the nerve against terror and hex-rot alike.

Scroll of Fire Bolt.name: Scroll of Fire Bolt
Scroll of Fire Bolt.flavor: Keep arid; damp parchment tends to ignite inside the scroll-case instead.
Scroll of Fire Bolt.inspect: Inscribed in soot-ink on cured sheepskin. Speaking the final syllable looses a whistling dart of searing ember.

Scroll of Fireball.name: Scroll of Fireball
Scroll of Fireball.flavor: Singed around all four margins by the scribe who proofread the last verse.
Scroll of Fireball.inspect: Bound with crimson waxed cord and smelling strongly of sulfur. Unfurls a roaring sphere that turns tight formations into ash and grease.

Scroll of Flame Burst.name: Scroll of Flame Burst
Scroll of Flame Burst.flavor: Read aloud at arm's length unless you prefer eyebrows painted on with charcoal.
Scroll of Flame Burst.inspect: Drafted by siege-mages during the Alder Bridge defense. Releases a sudden ring of scorching heat around the caster's boots.

Scroll of Ignite.name: Scroll of Ignite
Scroll of Ignite.flavor: Even holding the rolled vellum makes seasoned tinder curl in nearby pockets.
Scroll of Ignite.inspect: A terse three-line incantation favored by Redmarsh scouts. Sets oil, pitch, and wool ablaze with a snap of the thumb.

Scroll of Frost Bolt.name: Scroll of Frost Bolt
Scroll of Frost Bolt.flavor: Rime forms along the wax seal whenever the scroll is carried indoors.
Scroll of Frost Bolt.inspect: Written with pewter-ash ink on bleached vellum. Launches a needle of black ice that numbs limbs on impact.

Tome of Ice Storm.name: Tome of Ice Storm
Tome of Ice Storm.flavor: Its clasped covers are welded shut with frost that never melts.
Tome of Ice Storm.inspect: Recovered from a frozen watchtower north of the Smelted Coast. Calls down jagged hailstones stout enough to dent helm crowns.

Scroll of Chain Frost.name: Scroll of Chain Frost
Scroll of Chain Frost.flavor: The ink shifts across the page like frost patterns creeping over glass.
Scroll of Chain Frost.inspect: Annotated in trembling handwriting by an Oakhaven winter-adept. Releases a bouncing shard of cold that leaps from shield to shield.

Scroll of Healing.name: Scroll of Healing
Scroll of Healing.flavor: Smells faintly of crushed sage and clean linen amid battlefield mud.
Scroll of Healing.inspect: Copied by field chaplains who followed the Border Fords levies. Mends torn sinew and stops bleeding before shock sets in.

Tome of Healing Rain.name: Tome of Healing Rain
Tome of Healing Rain.flavor: Pages stay perpetually damp, smelling of summer storms over open fields.
Tome of Healing Rain.inspect: Bound in oiled sealskin for coastal campaigns. Summons a mercury-bright mist that washes grime and shallow wounds from an entire company.

Scroll of Lightning.name: Scroll of Lightning
Scroll of Lightning.flavor: Hair on the forearms stands straight up the moment the ribbon is untied.
Scroll of Lightning.inspect: Scratched onto copper-leaf parchment during a squall. Calls a jagged fork down from even a cloudless sky.

Tome of Chain Lightning.name: Tome of Chain Lightning
Tome of Chain Lightning.flavor: Smells of burnt hair and ozone; store well away from scabbards.
Tome of Chain Lightning.inspect: Chained inside a lead box until the Ironcamp siege. Arcs violently from one armored target to the next until grounded.

Scroll of Haste.name: Scroll of Haste
Scroll of Haste.flavor: The calligraphy slants forward so sharply the words nearly run off the page.
Scroll of Haste.inspect: Drafted by courier-mages who hated late dispatches. Quickens pulse and stride until blades blur in the air.

Scroll of Gale.name: Scroll of Gale
Scroll of Gale.flavor: Fluttering edges snap like a mainsail even inside a shuttered cellar.
Scroll of Gale.inspect: Used by Wrought-ore Coast harbor pilots to clear fog banks. Uncorks a battering blast of wind that bowls pikemen backward.

Scroll of Wind Ward.name: Scroll of Wind Ward
Scroll of Wind Ward.flavor: Light as a dried gull feather and impossible to lay flat on a table.
Scroll of Wind Ward.inspect: Inscribed along the cliffs above Burning Harbor. Wraps allies in screaming crosswinds that turn arrows harmlessly aside.

Scroll of Rock Throw.name: Scroll of Rock Throw
Scroll of Rock Throw.flavor: Gritty quartz dust spills from the folds every time the parchment bends.
Scroll of Rock Throw.inspect: A blunt peasant-hedge formula favored by quarry foremen. Hurls a fist-sized stone with the punch of a torsion sling.

Tome of Stone Curse.name: Tome of Stone Curse
Tome of Stone Curse.flavor: Burdened like a milestone and cold enough to numb bare fingers.
Tome of Stone Curse.inspect: Chiseled onto thin slate leaves bound with bronze rings. Turns rushing flesh sluggish and grey before locking joints solid.

Scroll of Stone Skin.name: Scroll of Stone Skin
Scroll of Stone Skin.flavor: The vellum feels rough as pumice and dulls any quill drawn across it.
Scroll of Stone Skin.inspect: Copied from boundary markers in the Deep Quarry. Hardens skin into pebbled grit that blunts shallow cuts.

Scroll of Poison Cloud.name: Scroll of Poison Cloud
Scroll of Poison Cloud.flavor: Sealed in oiled bladder-skin; yellow vapor leaks if the wax cracks.
Scroll of Poison Cloud.inspect: Brewed from swamp-adder bile and rotting bog-turnips. Fills a hollow with choking green fumes that rot lungs and hide alike.

Tome of Quake.name: Tome of Quake
Tome of Quake.flavor: Bookshelves shudder and dust sifts from rafters wherever this volume rests.
Tome of Quake.inspect: Bound in riveted plates stamped with broken towers. Splits flagstones and topples shield-walls in a rolling roar.

Scroll of Blessing.name: Scroll of Blessing
Scroll of Blessing.flavor: Gold leaf along the margin stays bright even in the filthiest trench.
Scroll of Blessing.inspect: Distributed by Oakhaven chaplains before dawn assaults. Steadies wavering ranks with brief, fierce certainty.

Scroll of Weaken.name: Scroll of Weaken
Scroll of Weaken.flavor: Written in faded gall-ink that makes the reader's shoulders slump.
Scroll of Weaken.inspect: Used by Ember Court tax-enforcers to break stubborn holdouts. Saps muscle and resolve until shields drag in the dirt.

Tome of Resurrect.name: Tome of Resurrect
Tome of Resurrect.flavor: Pages whisper names of the recently dead whenever left open at night.
Tome of Resurrect.inspect: Forbidden by three synods and hidden beneath the Sunken Sanctum. Drags a fresh corpse back to ragged, furious breath.

Scroll of Corpse Burst.name: Scroll of Corpse Burst
Scroll of Corpse Burst.flavor: Smells faintly of lard and saltpeter; do not read near exposed graves.
Scroll of Corpse Burst.inspect: Scrawled by a frantic necromancer cornered in Redmarsh. Turns fallen bodies into shrapnel of splintered bone and boiling blood.

Scroll of Meditation.name: Scroll of Meditation
Scroll of Meditation.flavor: Reading the first line slows your breathing; reading the last empties your purse.
Scroll of Meditation.inspect: Copied in calm, even script by Lantern Passage hermits. Quiets battlefield clamor so spent focus pools back swiftly.

Leather Gloves.name: Leather Gloves
Leather Gloves.flavor: Stiffened around the knuckles from gripping wet reins and tarnished hilts.
Leather Gloves.inspect: Tanned pigskin stitched with waxed linen. Keeps blisters off palms during forced marches through the Border Fords.

Iron Gauntlets.name: Iron Gauntlets
Iron Gauntlets.flavor: Articulated finger-plates rattle softly against wooden spear-shafts.
Iron Gauntlets.inspect: Riveted over dense buckskin mittens by Thornwick smiths. Turns a backhand punch into a solid blow with metal knuckles.

Steel Gauntlets.name: Steel Gauntlets
Steel Gauntlets.flavor: Fluted cuffs bear notch-marks where a mercenary counted his winter contracts.
Steel Gauntlets.inspect: Fitted closely enough to draw a bowstring yet sturdy enough to parry a dagger. Oiled weekly to keep sea-spray from seizing the rivets.

Silk Gloves.name: Silk Gloves
Silk Gloves.flavor: Dyed plum with lunate-thread cuffs that never catch on scroll ribbons.
Silk Gloves.inspect: Woven in Oakhaven for channelers whose fingers blister from raw aether. The fabric stays cool even when sparks dance across the palms.

Mithril Gale Buckler.name: Mithril Gale Buckler
Mithril Gale Buckler.flavor: Featherweight as a tin platter yet rings like an anvil when struck square.
Mithril Gale Buckler.inspect: Hammered from mountain alloy etched with wind-spirals. Deflects incoming bolts with a sharp whistling whine.

Adamantium Needle.name: Adamantium Needle
Adamantium Needle.flavor: A slender estoc that slides between mail rings without a sound.
Adamantium Needle.inspect: Forged in a lost foundry beneath the Pig-metal Coast. Built not for hacking, but for finding the narrow gap under a gorget.

Dragon Leather Mantle.name: Dragon Leather Mantle
Dragon Leather Mantle.flavor: Scales along the shoulders still smell faintly of sulfur and sodden ash.
Dragon Leather Mantle.inspect: Cured from a drake carcass dragged out of the Redmarsh sinkholes. Sizzling sparks and lamp-oil bead harmlessly off its pebbled hide.

Tome of Meteor.name: Tome of Meteor
Tome of Meteor.flavor: Singed calfskin bound in blackened metal that radiates tinder-crisp furnace heat.
Tome of Meteor.inspect: Penultimate work of a mad Ember Court astronomer. Calls a screaming lump of slag down from the upper dark.

Scroll of Inferno.name: Scroll of Inferno
Scroll of Inferno.flavor: The wax seal melts into scarlet tears whenever enemies draw within twenty paces.
Scroll of Inferno.inspect: Inscribed with charcoal harvested from burned chapels. Turns an entire patch of ground into a roaring kiln.

Tome of Blizzard.name: Tome of Blizzard
Tome of Blizzard.flavor: Icicles form along the spine whenever the book is opened indoors.
Tome of Blizzard.inspect: Recovered from a shipwreck locked in northern pack-ice. Blankets the field in blinding sleet that freezes boots to the mud.

Tome of Thunderstorm.name: Tome of Thunderstorm
Tome of Thunderstorm.flavor: Static arcs between the brass corners whenever rainclouds gather.
Tome of Thunderstorm.inspect: Chained to a lightning-rod atop Oakhaven's tallest spire. Unleashes rolling thunderbolts across an entire valley.

Scroll of Iron Skin.name: Scroll of Iron Skin
Scroll of Iron Skin.flavor: Written on hammered tin-foil rather than parchment; creases scream loudly.
Scroll of Iron Skin.inspect: Issued to vanguard stormers at Ironcamp Citadel. Turns flesh temporarily dull grey and hard as frigid pig-ore-cast.

Scroll of Acid Rain.name: Scroll of Acid Rain
Scroll of Acid Rain.flavor: Eats slowly through ordinary scroll-cases; keep wrapped in oiled canvas.
Scroll of Acid Rain.inspect: Brewed from vitriol recipes stolen out of Redmarsh laboratories. Brings down a hissing drizzle that pits plate and blisters skin.

Scroll of Mana Burn.name: Scroll of Mana Burn
Scroll of Mana Burn.flavor: The ink glows violet and tastes bitter on the air when unrolled.
Scroll of Mana Burn.inspect: Devised by witch-hunters hunting rogue Ember Court adepts. Detonates a caster's gathered power inside their own skull.

Tome of Time Warp.name: Tome of Time Warp
Tome of Time Warp.flavor: Its pages yellow and turn crisp again in the span of a solitary heartbeat.
Tome of Time Warp.inspect: Found ticking inside a sealed vault beneath the Sunken Citadel. Warps local seconds until allies strike twice before a foe blinks.

Woodcutter Handaxe.name: Woodcutter Handaxe
Woodcutter Handaxe.flavor: Nicked near the heel from hitting a buried horseshoe in Greywood.
Woodcutter Handaxe.inspect: Short hickory haft wedged tight with a metal shim. Meant for kindling, yet plenty lethal in a cramped ditch.

Bearded Battleaxe.name: Bearded Battleaxe
Bearded Battleaxe.flavor: The lower hook is ground shiny from dragging shields down in melee.
Bearded Battleaxe.inspect: Broad crescent head balanced for one-handed swings. Redmarsh raiders favor it because it splits rain-soaked oak planks with one chop.

Tempered War Axe.name: Tempered War Axe
Tempered War Axe.flavor: Blue-ashen edge honed on river slate until it shaves hair unmoistened.
Tempered War Axe.inspect: Forged in Oakhaven with a reinforced poll for cracking helms. Nimble enough to recover quickly after a missed overhead strike.

Crescent Broadaxe.name: Crescent Broadaxe
Crescent Broadaxe.flavor: Two-handed haft wrapped in tarred cord where blood once made wood slick.
Crescent Broadaxe.inspect: Sweeping curved bit built to shear through pike shafts and mail alike. Leaves a whistling wake every time it clears the shoulder.

Berserker Decapitator.name: Berserker Decapitator
Berserker Decapitator.flavor: Notched along the spine where its former owner chewed the blade before charges.
Berserker Decapitator.inspect: Brutally forward-heavy cleaver stained near the rivets. Built for men who have already decided not to walk back.

Spiked Cudgel.name: Spiked Cudgel
Spiked Cudgel.flavor: Seasoned ash knot studded with square-headed coffin nails.
Spiked Cudgel.inspect: Cheap, ugly, and brutally effective against hide and bone. Every levy camp outside Thornwick has a dozen leaning by the fire.

Flanged Mace.name: Flanged Mace
Flanged Mace.flavor: Six fins bent slightly from hammering against Forged-ore Coast plate.
Flanged Mace.inspect: Designed to cave in helmets where sword edges merely glance off. A wrist-loop keeps it from flying out of numb fingers.

Heavy Morningstar.name: Heavy Morningstar
Heavy Morningstar.flavor: Dried fen-moss still clings between the spikes of its flanged head.
Heavy Morningstar.inspect: Ash shaft banded with metal straps to survive parries. Punches clean holes through shield bosses and breastplates alike.

Steel Warhammer.name: Steel Warhammer
Steel Warhammer.flavor: Long rear beak darkened from prying apart riveted mail links.
Steel Warhammer.inspect: Compact head concentrating all its weight behind a narrow striking face. Favored by Ironcamp sergeants facing armored veterans.

Obsidian Greatmaul.name: Obsidian Greatmaul
Obsidian Greatmaul.flavor: Volcanic glass bound in black bronze that rings like struck crystal.
Obsidian Greatmaul.inspect: Quarried from the charred slopes near the Ember Court. Each blow sends numbing shockwaves straight through shield arms.

Flint Stiletto.name: Flint Stiletto
Flint Stiletto.flavor: Knapped glassy blade lashed to a bone handle with sinew.
Flint Stiletto.inspect: Brittle against plate, ruthless in the dark between ribs. Snaps cleanly if twisted, leaving a jagged souvenir inside.

Steel Rondel.name: Steel Rondel
Steel Rondel.flavor: Twin disc guards keep blood-slick fingers from sliding onto the triangular blade.
Steel Rondel.inspect: Built solely for punching through mail rings and visor slits. Every mercenary carries one as a final argument in the mud.

Duelist Poignard.name: Duelist Poignard
Duelist Poignard.flavor: Etched along the ricasso with the motto of a ruined Oakhaven fencing hall.
Duelist Poignard.inspect: Parrying dagger balanced to catch and trap heavier blades. Quick enough to dart past a guard before a wrist turns.

Main-Gauche.name: Main-Gauche
Main-Gauche.flavor: Swept knuckle-bow scarred by dozens of caught sword-edges.
Main-Gauche.inspect: Left-hand companion blade crafted for Slag-metal Coast duelists. Turns aside cuts while leaving the wielder's main hand free.

Shadow Dirk.name: Shadow Dirk
Shadow Dirk.flavor: Soot-blackened metal that swallows torchlight instead of gleaming.
Shadow Dirk.inspect: Issued to Ember Court whisper-agents operating behind enemy lines. Leaves glacial, bloodless punctures that ache extended after closing.

Two-Handed Claymore.name: Two-Handed Claymore
Two-Handed Claymore.flavor: Quatrefoil crossguard bent slightly from levering unsealed a barred gate.
Two-Handed Claymore.inspect: Lengthy plain blade requiring two hands and plenty of room to swing. Clears a wide semicircle through crowded ranks.

Bastard Greatsword.name: Bastard Greatsword
Bastard Greatsword.flavor: Wire-wrapped grip ground down to bare beechwood near the pommel.
Bastard Greatsword.inspect: Hand-and-a-half blade flexible enough for shield work or sweeping two-handed cuts. Popular among Border Fords veterans.

Flamberge.name: Flamberge
Flamberge.flavor: Undulating edge leaves ragged wounds that resist ordinary stitching.
Flamberge.inspect: Wavy blade forged to vibrate violently against parrying guards. Smiths hate sharpening it; surgeons hate cleaning up after it.

Executioner Blade.name: Executioner Blade
Executioner Blade.flavor: Square-tipped and massive, engraved with a scales-and-cinder emblem.
Executioner Blade.inspect: Balanced entirely for downward chopping rather than thrusting. Carried into battle by disgraced judges of the Ember Court.

Dreadnought Zweihander.name: Dreadnought Zweihander
Dreadnought Zweihander.flavor: Parrying lugs below the ricasso bear dents from pike-points.
Dreadnought Zweihander.inspect: Six feet of soot-darkened spring alloy built to wade into spear walls. Only men built like draft oxen last a full campaign swinging it.

Willow Wand.name: Willow Wand
Willow Wand.flavor: Peeling bark reveals wood faintly warm at the tip.
Willow Wand.inspect: Cut from river-bank trees near Thornwick. Simple, cheap, and prone to snapping if waved too wildly in panic.

Yew Wand.name: Yew Wand
Yew Wand.flavor: Rust-hued heartwood polished smooth by nervous thumbs.
Yew Wand.inspect: Carved from graveyard yews older than the Border Fords watchtowers. Channels sparks cleanly without scorching the grip.

Amber Focus Wand.name: Amber Focus Wand
Amber Focus Wand.flavor: A trapped prehistoric wasp gleams inside the resin knob.
Amber Focus Wand.inspect: Turned by Redmarsh craftsmen from bog-dredged amber. Holds static charge like baked wool before a winter storm.

Crystal Siphon Wand.name: Crystal Siphon Wand
Crystal Siphon Wand.flavor: Hexagonal quartz core clouds over whenever magic is drawn through it.
Crystal Siphon Wand.inspect: Assembled in Oakhaven workshops for field battlemages. Drinks ambient aether faster than wooden foci can manage.

Astral Archon Wand.name: Astral Archon Wand
Astral Archon Wand.flavor: Star-metal shaft inlaid with white-metal rings that spin softly on their own.
Astral Archon Wand.inspect: Relic of the pre-schism magisters. Bolts loosed from its tip leave faint violet trails hanging in the air.

Ash Shortbow.name: Ash Shortbow
Ash Shortbow.flavor: Stave wrapped in rawhide where damp weather once started a split.
Ash Shortbow.inspect: Hunting bow strung with waxed hemp. Quick to draw from behind cover, though weak against mail.

Recurve Bow.name: Recurve Bow
Recurve Bow.flavor: Horn tips laminated onto seasoned ash for extra snap in the draw.
Recurve Bow.inspect: Carried by Redmarsh outriders who shoot from slender causeways. Packs surprising punch for a bow short enough for brush.

Composite War Bow.name: Composite War Bow
Composite War Bow.flavor: Sinew-backed limbs lacquered black against salt spray and drizzle.
Composite War Bow.inspect: Requires a stout back to string and a calloused thumb to loose. Sends bodkins cleanly through nimble shields at a hundred paces.

Heavy Arbalest.name: Heavy Arbalest
Heavy Arbalest.flavor: Metal prod scarred with tally notches along the walnut tiller.
Heavy Arbalest.inspect: Spanned with a belt-hook and loud enough to wake half a valley. Punches quarrels straight through oak planks and brigandine.

Windpiercer Greatbow.name: Windpiercer Greatbow
Windpiercer Greatbow.flavor: Six-foot yew stave whose string hums a low note even at rest.
Windpiercer Greatbow.inspect: Crafted by master bowyers overlooking the Dark-ore Coast cliffs. Arrows loosed from it scream like gulls before striking home.

Steel Kite Shield.name: Steel Kite Shield
Steel Kite Shield.flavor: Tapered bottom point chipped from planting it into rocky ground.
Steel Kite Shield.inspect: Curved face protecting from shoulder to knee. Standard issue for Oakhaven spear-sergeants holding snug-fit bridges.

Aegis of the Citadel.name: Aegis of the Citadel
Aegis of the Citadel.flavor: Mirror-bright rim frames a char-stained central boss shaped like a sunburst.
Aegis of the Citadel.inspect: Forged for the personal guard of Ironcamp Citadel. Blows that should shatter bones rebound with a dull, harmless chime.

Novice Glass Focus.name: Novice Glass Focus
Novice Glass Focus.flavor: Blown green bottle-glass full of tiny air bubbles and one hairline crack.
Novice Glass Focus.inspect: Issued to first-year tower apprentices in Oakhaven. Cheap enough to replace when an overloaded spell shatters it in hand.

Chiseled Quartz Focus.name: Chiseled Quartz Focus
Chiseled Quartz Focus.flavor: Faceted milky crystal bound in pewter claws.
Chiseled Quartz Focus.inspect: Quarried from veins beneath the Border Fords hills. Splits raw magical force into tighter, steadier streams.

Astral Sphere.name: Astral Sphere
Astral Sphere.flavor: Hollow brass rings orbit a suspended drop of liquid starlight.
Astral Sphere.inspect: Calibrated by scholars studying the night sky above Redmarsh. Turns softly toward sources of unseen sorcery.

Radiant Spell-Mirror.name: Radiant Spell-Mirror
Radiant Spell-Mirror.flavor: Polished disc framed in bone that reflects faces a second late.
Radiant Spell-Mirror.inspect: Carried by mage-hunters of the Bloomery Coast. Incoming hexes splash across its surface like water hitting hot griddle.

Eye of the Cosmos.name: Eye of the Cosmos
Eye of the Cosmos.flavor: A slit-pupiled gemstone floating inside a cage of biting gold.
Eye of the Cosmos.inspect: Plucked from the crown of a fallen Ember Court oracle. Looking into its depths reveals threads of fate fraying in real time.

Steel Basinet.name: Steel Basinet
Steel Basinet.flavor: Pointed skull-cap with vervelles for hanging a mail aventail.
Steel Basinet.inspect: Sloped crown deflects downward cuts cleanly past the shoulders. Favored by hardened men-at-arms across all four provinces.

Dread Crest Helm.name: Dread Crest Helm
Dread Crest Helm.flavor: Visor shaped like a snarling hound with soot-stained eye slits.
Dread Crest Helm.inspect: Forged for shock captains leading assaults into Ember Court territory. Just seeing its silhouette breaks the nerve of raw levies.

Apprentice Circlet.name: Apprentice Circlet
Apprentice Circlet.flavor: Thin brass band tarnished green behind the ears.
Apprentice Circlet.inspect: Set with a pebble of blue feldspar to help focus wandering thoughts. Every young caster in Oakhaven starts with one.

Sage Cowl.name: Sage Cowl
Sage Cowl.flavor: Coarse slate-hued wool hood lined with faded silk script.
Sage Cowl.inspect: Draped over elders who keep the Lantern Passage archives. Blocks out drafty corridors and stray psychic static alike.

Archmage Diadem.name: Archmage Diadem
Archmage Diadem.flavor: Interlocking crescents cradling a diamond over the brow.
Archmage Diadem.inspect: Badge of rank in the Oakhaven conclave. Icy clarity settles behind the eyes the moment it touches the forehead.

Stalker Hood.name: Stalker Hood
Stalker Hood.flavor: Oilskin cowl stained with peat-smoke and leaf-mold to break up silhouettes.
Stalker Hood.inspect: Tailored for Redmarsh pathfinders who move through reeds before dawn. Keeps rain off the neck without muffling footsteps.

Shadow Mask.name: Shadow Mask
Shadow Mask.flavor: Steeped ebon hide molded featureless save for constricted eye-slits.
Shadow Mask.inspect: Donned by Ember Court night-blades during political purges. Even torchlight seems reluctant to catch on its matte surface.

Interlocking Ring Mail.name: Interlocking Ring Mail
Interlocking Ring Mail.flavor: Double-linked rings dense enough to stop a bodkin point.
Interlocking Ring Mail.inspect: Hauberk oiled with mutton fat against Redmarsh humidity. Moves like metal cloth over a padded gambeson.

Gothic Full Plate.name: Gothic Full Plate
Gothic Full Plate.flavor: Rippled plates channeled to guide lance tips away from joints.
Gothic Full Plate.inspect: Masterwork of Ironcamp's finest guildsmiths. Turns a warrior into a walking fortress at the cost of every coin in their chest.

Studded Leather Armor.name: Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.flavor: Hardened oxhide reinforced with rows of domed rivets.
Studded Leather Armor.inspect: Lighter than mail and quieter in brush. Favored by scouts and caravan guards patrolling the Greywood roads.

Hardened Brigandine.name: Hardened Brigandine
Hardened Brigandine.flavor: Hundreds of overlapping plates riveted inside crimson canvas.
Hardened Brigandine.inspect: Looks like a nobleman's doublet until a blade strikes hidden metal. Easy to repair on campaign with a hammer and spare rivets.

Wyrmscale Cuirass.name: Wyrmscale Cuirass
Wyrmscale Cuirass.flavor: Iridescent scales stitched onto dragon-sinew backing that clinks softly.
Wyrmscale Cuirass.inspect: Stripped from an elder marsh-wyrm slain after three weeks of siege. Laughs off fire, frost, and blades alike.

Weaver Robe.name: Weaver Robe
Weaver Robe.flavor: Patterned with geometric knots that make the eyes water if stared at.
Weaver Robe.inspect: Loomed by silent guild-weavers in Oakhaven. Each thread is spun around a hair-slender copper filament to ground stray sparks.

Mystic Velvet Mantle.name: Mystic Velvet Mantle
Mystic Velvet Mantle.flavor: Burgundy pile trimmed with ermine stained leaden at the hem.
Mystic Velvet Mantle.inspect: Draped on advisors in the Ember Court before the fall. Heavy-ply enough to turn aside chill winds and minor hexes.

Steel Greaves.name: Steel Greaves
Steel Greaves.flavor: Hinged shin-guards buckled over wool leggings.
Steel Greaves.inspect: Protect the lower legs from sweeping cuts in shield-wall crushes. Scratched bright along the ankles from rocky trails.

Juggernaut War Greaves.name: Juggernaut War Greaves
Juggernaut War Greaves.flavor: Flanged plate leg-armor sturdy enough to crack cobbles on a hard stomp.
Juggernaut War Greaves.inspect: Forged for frontline breachers at Ironcamp Citadel. Once planted, the wearer yields ground only when dead.

Tracker Treads.name: Tracker Treads
Tracker Treads.flavor: Soft-soled deerhide boots laced crosswise up the calf.
Tracker Treads.inspect: Built by border trappers who follow wolf packs across frozen fens. Silent on parched leaves and steady on clammy stone.

Windrunner Striders.name: Windrunner Striders
Windrunner Striders.flavor: Wing-stamped calfskin boots that feel half-empty even when laced taut.
Windrunner Striders.inspect: Enchanted in Oakhaven for scouts outrunning cavalry patrols. Dust barely rises behind the heels at a full sprint.

Scholar Slippers.name: Scholar Slippers
Scholar Slippers.flavor: Felt-soled house shoes ground delicate from pacing library floors.
Scholar Slippers.inspect: Quiet enough not to wake snoring archivists in Lantern Passage. Useless in mud, oddly comforting during vigils.

Astral Walkers.name: Astral Walkers
Astral Walkers.flavor: Midnight-blue boots stitched with sterling thread that leaves faint footprints.
Astral Walkers.inspect: Crafted for tower magisters crossing treacherous planar thresholds. Stones and roots seem to shift out of the wearer's path.

Titan War Gauntlets.name: Titan War Gauntlets
Titan War Gauntlets.flavor: Oversized articulated gauntlets scarred from catching falling portcullises.
Titan War Gauntlets.inspect: Forged from dense meteoric alloy for champions of Ironcamp. A lone backhand can cave in a breastplate.

Studded Bracers.name: Studded Bracers
Studded Bracers.flavor: Forearm guards capped with brass strips.
Studded Bracers.inspect: Strapped over sleeves by archers and skirmishers alike. Deflects glancing cuts and keeps bowstrings from bruising wrists.

Reinforced Vambraces.name: Reinforced Vambraces
Reinforced Vambraces.flavor: Spring-metal splints riveted over simmered hide.
Reinforced Vambraces.inspect: Issued to Oakhaven pikemen tired of losing forearms in close press. Nimble enough not to slow a thrust.

Shadowstrike Grips.name: Shadowstrike Grips
Shadowstrike Grips.flavor: Supple pitch-dark kidskin gloves with lead-weighted knuckles.
Shadowstrike Grips.inspect: Favored by Ember Court assassins scaling drenched castle walls. Fingers keep full sensitivity while palms bite snug onto stone.

Novice Wraps.name: Novice Wraps
Novice Wraps.flavor: Inked linen strips wound tightly around knuckles and wrists.
Novice Wraps.inspect: Used by apprentices practicing fire-cantrips before they learn control. Prevents minor burns from blistering the palms.

Velvet Channelers.name: Velvet Channelers
Velvet Channelers.flavor: Fingerless crimson gloves embroidered with conduits.
Velvet Channelers.inspect: Tailored for battle-casters who need bare fingertips for somatic signs. Draws ambient magic smoothly up the forearms.

Archon Handwraps.name: Archon Handwraps
Archon Handwraps.flavor: Gold-threaded silk bandages that never fray or stain with soot.
Archon Handwraps.inspect: Relic bindings carried by the warden of the Celestial Spire. Spells leap from the fingertips with terrifying speed.

Copper Band.name: Copper Band
Copper Band.flavor: Hammered from a melted-down Border Fords halfpenny.
Copper Band.inspect: Leaves a verdigris ring around the finger after a day in the rain. Costs almost nothing and brings modest luck at dice.

Bone Ring.name: Bone Ring
Bone Ring.flavor: Carved from a knuckle-bone smoothed yellow by decades of use.
Bone Ring.inspect: Sold by grave-diggers outside Thornwick after winter plagues. Chill against the skin whenever undead stir nearby.

Ring of Valor.name: Ring of Valor
Ring of Valor.flavor: Bronze signet stamped with a broken spear.
Ring of Valor.inspect: Awarded to survivors of the Alder Bridge rear-guard. Pulse beats steadier when outnumbered three to one.

Ring of the Scribe.name: Ring of the Scribe
Ring of the Scribe.flavor: Argent band shaped like a coiled quill nib.
Ring of the Scribe.inspect: Kept by clerks in Oakhaven's registry. Ink never blots and spells read faster under its sheen.

Ring of the Champions.name: Ring of the Champions
Ring of the Champions.flavor: Crown-shaped gold band set with three blood-vermilion spinels.
Ring of the Champions.inspect: Won in the brutal pit-tournaments of Ironcamp Citadel. Fills the sword-arm with tireless, ruthless strength.

Ring of the High Archon.name: Ring of the High Archon
Ring of the High Archon.flavor: Platinum loop cradling a star-sapphire that hums when spells are cast.
Ring of the High Archon.inspect: Passed down among heads of the Oakhaven conclave. Vast reserves of arcane power answer its silent call.

Signet of Unbroken Vigor.name: Signet of Unbroken Vigor
Signet of Unbroken Vigor.flavor: Seal stamped with an oak root splitting granite.
Signet of Unbroken Vigor.inspect: Carried by marshals who marched across Redmarsh without a sick-day. Wounds knit faster while it rests on the hand.

Clay Talisman.name: Clay Talisman
Clay Talisman.flavor: Thumb-pressed river clay baked hard and strung on hemp.
Clay Talisman.inspect: Sold at Thornwick market stalls to nervous farmers. Mostly superstition, though it occasionally turns aside a hex.

Bronze Locket.name: Bronze Locket
Bronze Locket.flavor: Hinged oval case holding a lock of faded hair and dried lavender.
Bronze Locket.inspect: Found in the pack of a soldier who never made it home from Ravenwatch. Keeps a stubborn spark of hope alive in the dark.

Astral Medallion.name: Astral Medallion
Astral Medallion.flavor: Astrolabe pendant whose tiny pointers never stop turning.
Astral Medallion.inspect: Crafted by Redmarsh star-watchers tracking omens over the Ember Court. Sharpens magical focus under unroofed skies.

Bloodstone Pendant.name: Bloodstone Pendant
Bloodstone Pendant.flavor: Moss-hued jasper flecked with crimson spots like fresh splatter.
Bloodstone Pendant.inspect: Carried by Anvil-wrought Coast surgeons and mercenaries alike. Slows bleeding when blades bite deep into flesh.

Prismatic Choker.name: Prismatic Choker
Prismatic Choker.flavor: Seven tiny cut gems set in links that flash different colors.
Prismatic Choker.inspect: Looted from a ruined Ember Court treasury vault. Scatters incoming elemental magic across the spectrum.

Heart of the Colossus.name: Heart of the Colossus
Heart of the Colossus.flavor: Fist-sized banded ruby that thuds softly against the chest plate.
Heart of the Colossus.inspect: Torn from the chest of an ancient siege-golem beneath Ironcamp. Grants towering endurance to warriors who bear its weight.

Medallion of the Celestial Spire.name: Medallion of the Celestial Spire
Medallion of the Celestial Spire.flavor: A shard of white crystal suspended inside a ring of charcoal star-ferric.
Medallion of the Celestial Spire.inspect: Recovered from the ruin overlooking the Ember Court. Channels blinding celestial authority through its bearer's will.

Alder Pike.name: Alder Pike
Alder Pike.flavor: Eight feet of seasoned river-ash tipped with a notched iron bodkin for holding muddy fords.

Border Billhook.name: Border Billhook
Border Billhook.flavor: Originally forged for clearing riverside briars, now sharpened on both edges for unhorsing raiders.

Militia Halberd.name: Militia Halberd
Militia Halberd.flavor: Stained with river-mud and tallow where Thornwick watchmen rested the butt-spike during night patrols.

Ferryman's Gaff.name: Ferryman's Gaff
Ferryman's Gaff.flavor: A heavy iron boat-hook balanced enough to haul drowned cargo or snag a brigand's shield-rim.

Bog-Iron Falchion.name: Bog-Iron Falchion
Bog-Iron Falchion.flavor: Broad, clip-pointed blade smelted from Redmarsh ore; heavy enough to cleave wet peat and leather.

Peat-Cutter's Cleaver.name: Peat-Cutter's Cleaver
Peat-Cutter's Cleaver.flavor: Squared iron chopper hammered flat on the spine so it doubles as a tent-peg mallet.

Sunken-Ruin Gladius.name: Sunken-Ruin Gladius
Sunken-Ruin Gladius.flavor: Short bronze-hilted stabbing blade pulled from a fenland barrow with faint verdigris in the fuller.

Fenland Sickle-Blade.name: Fenland Sickle-Blade
Fenland Sickle-Blade.flavor: Curved harvesting iron bound to an oak grip with tarred hemp; favored by marsh heretics.

Corsair Boarding Cutlass.name: Corsair Boarding Cutlass
Corsair Boarding Cutlass.flavor: Basket-hilted sea-iron scarred by salt spray and parried boat-hooks along the Iron Coast.

Harpoon Spear.name: Harpoon Spear
Harpoon Spear.flavor: Barbed iron head lashed to a stout pine shaft with a ring for a trailing retrieval rope.

Mariner's Belaying Club.name: Mariner's Belaying Club
Mariner's Belaying Club.flavor: Dense ironwood pin weighted at the tip with poured lead for close brawls on pitching decks.

Shipwright's Adze.name: Shipwright's Adze
Shipwright's Adze.flavor: Curved timber-shaping blade sharp enough to split seasoned oak planks—or an unarmored skull.

Foundry Maul.name: Foundry Maul
Foundry Maul.flavor: Soot-blackened sledgehammer used to crack open cooling slag molds in the royal armories.

Inquisitor's Glaive.name: Inquisitor's Glaive
Inquisitor's Glaive.flavor: Long blackened polearm stamped with the Cinder Throne's judicial seal along the socket.

Cinder-Guard Partisan.name: Cinder-Guard Partisan
Cinder-Guard Partisan.flavor: Broad-winged ceremonial spear whose gilded lugs have been ground keen for street fighting.

Obsidian-Tipped Spear.name: Obsidian-Tipped Spear
Obsidian-Tipped Spear.flavor: Knapped volcanic glass bound into an ashwood socket; brittle against plate, lethal in flesh.

Willow Longbow.name: Willow Longbow
Willow Longbow.flavor: Supple river-willow stave oiled against dampness; draws smooth even when mist clings to the string.

Horn-Tipped Flatbow.name: Horn-Tipped Flatbow
Horn-Tipped Flatbow.flavor: Wide-limbed border bow reinforced with boiled ox-horn nocks to handle heavy bodkin shafts.

Border Patrol Crossbow.name: Border Patrol Crossbow
Border Patrol Crossbow.flavor: Stirrup-cocked iron prod issued to bridge sentries who needed steady aim over long river watches.

Poacher's Sling-Staff.name: Poacher's Sling-Staff
Poacher's Sling-Staff.flavor: Four-foot hazel rod fitted with a leather pouch for hurling smooth river cobbles silently.

Reed-Wrapped Bow.name: Reed-Wrapped Bow
Reed-Wrapped Bow.flavor: Camouflaged with braided sedge-grass so hunters can draw unseen from Redmarsh blind-huts.

Bog-Oak Crossbow.name: Bog-Oak Crossbow
Bog-Oak Crossbow.flavor: Stock carved from blackened fen-timber that refuses to warp in endless swamp humidity.

Salt-Cured Recurve.name: Salt-Cured Recurve
Salt-Cured Recurve.flavor: Sinew-backed coastal bow sealed in seal-blubber grease to keep the sea-spray out.

Whalebone Arbalest.name: Whalebone Arbalest
Whalebone Arbalest.flavor: Heavy marine crossbow inlaid with scrimshaw depth-marks along its grooved bolt-track.

Soot-Stained Greatbow.name: Soot-Stained Greatbow
Soot-Stained Greatbow.flavor: Six-foot yew warbow darkened by capital smoke; requires a steel gauntlet to draw cleanly.

Citadel Siege Crossbow.name: Citadel Siege Crossbow
Citadel Siege Crossbow.flavor: Winch-drawn steel prod built to punch iron bolts through reinforced oak mantlets.

River-Driftwood Staff.name: River-Driftwood Staff
River-Driftwood Staff.flavor: Bleached smooth by spring currents and bound at the crown with tarnished copper wire.

Alder Divining Rod.name: Alder Divining Rod
Alder Divining Rod.flavor: Forked branch cut during a new moon; hums faintly whenever groundwater or ley-streams run beneath.

Peat-Charred Quarterstaff.name: Peat-Charred Quarterstaff
Peat-Charred Quarterstaff.flavor: Fire-hardened bog-oak shod with iron ferrules to keep from sinking into soft marsh turf.

Mire-Wisp Lantern Rod.name: Mire-Wisp Lantern Rod
Mire-Wisp Lantern Rod.flavor: Crooked ash staff fitted with a brass hook for carrying glowing marsh-gas cages safely.

Sea-Glass Focus Staff.name: Sea-Glass Focus Staff
Sea-Glass Focus Staff.flavor: Crowned with a thick chunk of wave-frosted green bottle glass that scatters lightning sparks.

Brine-Bleached Crozier.name: Brine-Bleached Crozier
Brine-Bleached Crozier.flavor: Curved driftwood shepherd's crook crusted with dried salt crystals from coastal vigils.

Cinder-Core Spire Staff.name: Cinder-Core Spire Staff
Cinder-Core Spire Staff.flavor: Hollowed ironwood rod packed with warm foundry slag that radiates a steady, dry heat.

Vitrified Slag Rod.name: Vitrified Slag Rod
Vitrified Slag Rod.flavor: Twisted shaft of fused black glass pulled from the ruins of an incinerated chancellery.

River-Clay Totem.name: River-Clay Totem
River-Clay Totem.flavor: Sun-baked tablet pressed with the crossed-hammer sigil of the First Border Compact.

Tallow-Sealed Scroll Tube.name: Tallow-Sealed Scroll Tube
Tallow-Sealed Scroll Tube.flavor: Waterproofed leather cylinder used by border couriers to keep parchment dry through rainstorms.

Bog-Amber Fetish.name: Bog-Amber Fetish
Bog-Amber Fetish.flavor: Cloudy yellow resin enclosing a preserved marsh-midge; feels strangely warm in cold fog.

Cracked Bronze Censer.name: Cracked Bronze Censer
Cracked Bronze Censer.flavor: Smells permanently of dried wormwood and swamp-sage burned to ward off quarantine fevers.

Barnacle-Encrusted Idol.name: Barnacle-Encrusted Idol
Barnacle-Encrusted Idol.flavor: Small soapstone sea-god dredged from an Iron Coast wreck, worn smooth by centuries of surf.

Navigator's Brass Quadrant.name: Navigator's Brass Quadrant
Navigator's Brass Quadrant.flavor: Salt-pitted sighting tool whose engraved degree-marks still catch stray beams of starlight.

Ashen Reliquary Box.name: Ashen Reliquary Box
Ashen Reliquary Box.flavor: Lead-lined miniature casket holding consecrated gray dust from Oakhaven's fallen sanctuary.

Ember-Glass Prism.name: Ember-Glass Prism
Ember-Glass Prism.flavor: Faceted shard of melted cathedral window that turns dull torchlight into sharp crimson rays.

Tarred Plank Buckler.name: Tarred Plank Buckler
Tarred Plank Buckler.flavor: Caulked oak barrel-lid fitted with an iron boss; floats if dropped in a river skirmish.

Border Watch Pavise.name: Border Watch Pavise
Border Watch Pavise.flavor: Tall, scarred wooden shield with a pointed base-spike meant to be planted firmly in gravel.

Bog-Oak Round Shield.name: Bog-Oak Round Shield
Bog-Oak Round Shield.flavor: Dense black timber bound in rawhide; absorbs axe blows without splitting in damp weather.

Whale-Hide Targe.name: Whale-Hide Targe
Whale-Hide Targe.flavor: Stretched marine leather cured in brine until it turns harder than boiled ox-hide.

Soot-Scored Heater Shield.name: Soot-Scored Heater Shield
Soot-Scored Heater Shield.flavor: Triangular royal infantry shield whose painted crest has been blistered away by ash-winds.

Militia Kettle Hat.name: Militia Kettle Hat
Militia Kettle Hat.flavor: Wide-brimmed iron helm prized by bridge sentries for keeping both rain and arrows off their necks.

Otter-Pelt Trapper Cap.name: Otter-Pelt Trapper Cap
Otter-Pelt Trapper Cap.flavor: Greasy fur-lined hood with ear-flaps that tie snugly beneath the chin against river gales.

Peat-Stained Coif.name: Peat-Stained Coif
Peat-Stained Coif.flavor: Heavy quilted linen hood worn beneath iron helms to cushion blows and soak up swamp sweat.

Beekeeper's Midge-Hood.name: Beekeeper's Midge-Hood
Beekeeper's Midge-Hood.flavor: Woven rush frame draped in fine horsehair netting to keep biting bog-flies out of the eyes.

Oilskin Sou'wester.name: Oilskin Sou'wester
Oilskin Sou'wester.flavor: Broad-brimmed tarred canvas hat with an elongated back-flap that channels sea-spray off the collar.

Salt-Raker's Eye-Shade.name: Salt-Raker's Eye-Shade
Salt-Raker's Eye-Shade.flavor: Slitted driftwood visor tied with hemp cord to prevent snow-blindness on glaring brine flats.

Ash-Filter Respirator Mask.name: Ash-Filter Respirator Mask
Ash-Filter Respirator Mask.flavor: Boiled leather snout stuffed with damp charcoal and wool to strain stinging cinders from the air.

Pyre-Guard Visored Helm.name: Pyre-Guard Visored Helm
Pyre-Guard Visored Helm.flavor: Heavy blackened steel sallet with narrow eye-slits built to withstand flying foundry sparks.

Homespun Gambeson.name: Homespun Gambeson
Homespun Gambeson.flavor: Stuffed with raw sheep's wool and horsehair; stiff enough to turn a glancing knife thrust.

Tarred Ferryman's Coat.name: Tarred Ferryman's Coat
Tarred Ferryman's Coat.flavor: Heavy canvas greatcoat painted with pine-pitch until it stands upright on its own.

Waxed Bog-Wader Jerkin.name: Waxed Bog-Wader Jerkin
Waxed Bog-Wader Jerkin.flavor: Double-stitched leather vest rubbed weekly with tallow so stagnant water beads right off.

Scale-Sewn Fen Coat.name: Scale-Sewn Fen Coat
Scale-Sewn Fen Coat.flavor: Overlapping plates of cured gar-fish scales riveted onto tough marsh-reed canvas.

Seal-Skin Mariner Tunic.name: Seal-Skin Mariner Tunic
Seal-Skin Mariner Tunic.flavor: Supple coastal hide lined with gull-down to keep out the freezing spray of the Iron Coast.

Corroded Ring Hauberk.name: Corroded Ring Hauberk
Corroded Ring Hauberk.flavor: Salt-pitted mail shirt salvaged from a sunken patrol galley; still holds together despite the rust.

Mica-Plated Brigandine.name: Mica-Plated Brigandine
Mica-Plated Brigandine.flavor: Layered heat-resistant mineral sheets sandwiched between blackened canvas and steel rivets.

Cinder-Slicked Surcoat.name: Cinder-Slicked Surcoat
Cinder-Slicked Surcoat.flavor: Heavy wool tabard treated with alum-wash so drifting embers smolder out without catching.

Fen-Wader Thigh Boots.name: Fen-Wader Thigh Boots
Fen-Wader Thigh Boots.flavor: High-laced oiled leather boots fitted with brass drainage eyelets near the ankles.

Bog-Oak Clogs.name: Bog-Oak Clogs
Bog-Oak Clogs.flavor: Carved wooden overshoes strapped over leather boots to keep feet dry on flooded boardwalks.

Kelp-Soled Cliff Boots.name: Kelp-Soled Cliff Boots
Kelp-Soled Cliff Boots.flavor: Rough-buffed calfskin soles scored with cross-hatches for grip on wet coastal basalt.

Iron-Shod Ash Walkers.name: Iron-Shod Ash Walkers
Iron-Shod Ash Walkers.flavor: Thick hobnailed soles insulated with cork so hot cinders won't blister the wearer's feet.

Rope-Calloused Mitts.name: Rope-Calloused Mitts
Rope-Calloused Mitts.flavor: Reinforced palm-guards worn by river barge-men when hauling wet hemp tow-lines.

Tallow-Greased Bracers.name: Tallow-Greased Bracers
Tallow-Greased Bracers.flavor: Boiled leather forearm guards polished smooth so mud and swamp-slime wipe away easily.

Barnacle-Scraper Gauntlets.name: Barnacle-Scraper Gauntlets
Barnacle-Scraper Gauntlets.flavor: Thick iron-knuckled gloves used by Ironcamp dockhands to clear hulls and break jaws.

Foundry Tongs-Grips.name: Foundry Tongs-Grips
Foundry Tongs-Grips.flavor: Quilted asbestos-cloth mitts worn when handling red-hot crucibles in the capital's works.

Tarnished Toll-Token.name: Tarnished Toll-Token
Tarnished Toll-Token.flavor: Stamped brass river-pass drilled with a hole and hung on a leather thong for good luck.

Alder-Seed Rosary.name: Alder-Seed Rosary
Alder-Seed Rosary.flavor: Dried river-alder cones strung on waxed linen thread by border pilgrims.

Dried Toad-Foot Charm.name: Dried Toad-Foot Charm
Dried Toad-Foot Charm.flavor: Common Redmarsh folk-ward believed to turn away swamp-ague and false lantern-lights.

Bog-Iron Signet.name: Bog-Iron Signet
Bog-Iron Signet.flavor: Rough-cast dark metal ring stamped with the three-reed mark of a fenland drainage guild.

Sea-Glass Pendant.name: Sea-Glass Pendant
Sea-Glass Pendant.flavor: Teardrop of frosted blue glass wrapped in silver wire; sailors swear it warns of sudden squalls.

Shark-Tooth Ring.name: Shark-Tooth Ring
Shark-Tooth Ring.flavor: Serrated fossil tooth set into a band of hammered ship-nail iron.

Clinker-Ash Locket.name: Clinker-Ash Locket
Clinker-Ash Locket.flavor: Small blackened iron capsule holding a pinch of gray dust from a burned ancestral hearth.

Vitrified Glass Band.name: Vitrified Glass Band
Vitrified Glass Band.flavor: Smoky ring ground from sand melted by crown-fire during the capital riots.

Sealed Ration Tin.name: Sealed Ration Tin
Sealed Ration Tin.flavor: Soldered pewter box holding salted hardtack and dried river-berries safe from swamp damp.
